_note: SHARED by three Railway services (api, worker, scheduler) — all have Root Directory = backend, so all read THIS file. Railway config-as-code OVERRIDES dashboard settings, so this file must contain ONLY what is common to all three (build + restart policy). It must NOT set startCommand or healthcheck*: doing so forces worker/scheduler to run the API (and applies an HTTP healthcheck to non-HTTP services), defeating their per-service Custom Start Command overrides. Per-service start commands: api -> Dockerfile CMD default (scripts/start-api.sh); worker/scheduler -> Custom Start Command in the Railway dashboard (scripts/start-worker.sh / start-scheduler.sh). api's /health healthcheck is set in the api service's dashboard, NOT here. See infra/railway/*.json.
